$comment: The ETP v1.2 error codes. These are NOT in the .avsc schemas: ProtocolException
carries a bare integer, so this table is declared, and doc/design/etp-et-osdu/plan-etp.md
palier 0 has the test that keeps it honest.
Source: ETP Specification v1.2 / Document v1.1 (Sept. 27, 2021), chapter 24,
pages 482-486. The 'notes' are our own one-line glosses, not the spec's text.
Rules from section 24.1, and they are the reason this file exists:
- positive codes are reserved to Energistics; a custom code MUST be negative;
- since v1.2, any code may be used in any protocol, so a code does not imply
a protocol and must never be decoded as one.
The 'since' field records the protocol a code was introduced for, purely as
documentation: it is not a constraint, per the rule above.

codes.name: ENOROLE
codes.notes: The requested role is not one this endpoint plays.

codes.name: ENOSUPPORTEDPROTOCOLS
codes.notes: No protocol in common between the two endpoints.

codes.name: EINVALID_MESSAGETYPE
codes.notes: The messageType is unknown for that protocol.

codes.name: EUNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL
codes.notes: A message arrived for a protocol not negotiated.

codes.name: EINVALID_ARGUMENT
codes.notes: A field in the message body is unusable.

codes.name: EREQUEST_DENIED
codes.notes: Refused on purpose; the message should say why.

codes.name: ENOTSUPPORTED
codes.notes: The operation itself is not implemented here.

codes.name: EINVALID_STATE
codes.notes: Legal message, wrong moment in the protocol.

codes.name: EINVALID_URI
codes.notes: Malformed URI, or an alternate form the peer does not accept.

codes.name: EAUTHORIZATION_EXPIRED
codes.notes: Authorization ran out; the session is about to end.

codes.name: ENOT_FOUND
codes.notes: No such resource, data object, part or range.

codes.name: ELIMIT_EXCEEDED
codes.notes: A stated capability limit was passed, with no finer code available.

codes.name: ECOMPRESSION_NOTSUPPORTED
codes.notes: A Core (protocol 0) message arrived compressed, which is never allowed.

codes.name: EINVALID_OBJECT
codes.notes: The data object sent does not parse or does not validate.

codes.name: EMAX_TRANSACTIONS_EXCEEDED
codes.notes: Too many concurrent transactions.

codes.name: EDATAOBJECTTYPE_NOTSUPPORTED
codes.notes: That data object type was not agreed for this session.

codes.name: EMAXSIZE_EXCEEDED
codes.notes: A single object, part or array is over the declared maximum.

codes.name: EMULTIPART_CANCELLED
codes.notes: A multipart request, response or notification was abandoned.

codes.name: EINVALID_MESSAGE
codes.notes: The message header could not be deserialized; sent with protocol 0 and correlationId 0.

codes.name: EINVALID_INDEXKIND
codes.notes: The index kind does not match the channel or growing object.

codes.name: ENOSUPPORTEDFORMATS
codes.notes: No data format in common (xml, json, ...).

codes.name: EREQUESTUUID_REJECTED
codes.notes: The requestUuid offered for a subscription was refused.

codes.name: EUPDATEGROWINGOBJECT_DENIED
codes.notes: A growing object cannot be updated that way.

codes.name: EBACKPRESSURE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
codes.notes: Send queue exhausted; the sender closes the session right after.

codes.name: EBACKPRESSURE_WARNING
codes.notes: Send queue filling up; slow down.

codes.name: ETIMED_OUT
codes.notes: A response or multipart timeout period was passed.

codes.name: EAUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED
codes.notes: Sent during session negotiation only, to ask for authorization.

codes.name: EAUTHORIZATION_EXPIRING
codes.notes: Warning: renew the authorization or the connection ends.

codes.name: ENOSUPPORTEDDATAOBJECTTYPES
codes.notes: No data object type in common.

codes.name: ERESPONSECOUNT_EXCEEDED
codes.notes: A non-map response was cut short at the declared response limit; there is more data.

codes.name: EINVALID_APPEND
codes.notes: The append would break index ordering.

codes.name: EINVALID_OPERATION
codes.notes: The operation is not valid for that object or that state.

codes.name: EINVALID_CHANNELID
codes.notes: Unknown channel id.

codes.name: ENOCASCADE_DELETE
codes.notes: Deleting a container would orphan contained objects, and cascade was not requested.

codes.name: EPLURAL_OBJECT
codes.notes: One URI resolved to several objects where one was required.

codes.name: ERETENTION_PERIOD_EXCEEDED
codes.notes: The change history asked for is older than the store keeps; a full reload is needed.

codes.name: ENOTGROWINGOBJECT
codes.notes: The URI names an object that is not a growing object.
